4

Use it and make it yours

Questions

Do I need to know how to code?

No. If you can upload a file and paste a message into Claude, you can set this up.

What do I need to use these?

A Claude account at claude.ai or in the Claude app. Each app is built and tested to run there.

Do I need a paid Claude plan?

[Answer after testing on a free Claude account.]

Is this a subscription?

No. You pay once and the app is yours to keep and change however you like.

Where is my information saved?

Some apps save to your Claude account so your info follows you to any device. Others save in your browser. Each guide tells you exactly where your info lives and how to back it up.

Can I use them on my phone?

Yes. Open your app's link while signed in to Claude, in the Claude app or your phone's browser.

Do they connect to my email platform or calendar?

No. The apps help you plan and write. When something's ready, you copy it into the tools you already use.

Can I change the colors and wording?

Yes. Every app includes copy-and-paste prompts to add your name, brand colors and fonts, and more.

What if I get stuck?

Each guide has fix-it prompts for the most common hiccups. Still stuck? Email me at contact@monaweathers.com and I'll help you sort it out.
